x: "I've never known a team with such spirit!" So said Yacin Yusuf after his first outing with the Bels. It was the first time that we had ventured to the home of Chiltern Harriers AC to tackle their 6 x 2.8 miles road relay, nicely timed just two weeks before the SEAA 12-Stage and thus enabling a few…
Yacin Yusuf followed up by taking another five places and for the first time we went into the top ten and overtook our local rivals Thames Hare & Hounds right on the line with one stage remaining.

Lee Hurst was among the early leaders as the field set off in the direction of White Lodge but on the return from the loop four men had broken away - Gary Staines (SLH) and Sam Haughian (Hounslow) accompanied by our own Yacin Yusuf and Yitbarak Dinku.

The 1500 metres found the smallest runner, Belgrave team mascot Yacin Yusuf, up against some stronger looking competitors but did well to come home a very welcome 2nd behind Samir of France a 3m 35s runner.
For the Bels, after one lap, Yacin Yusuf and Paul Freary were handily placed at the front of the chasing pack with a whole bunch of claret and gold vests around the 20s.

A smoothly running Yacin Yusuf opened up the lead to 28 seconds on his stint and with Spencer Barden running the fastest of the day, our advantage was over one and a quarter minutes by the time Spenny raised his arms aloft at the race end.
